public.text: The scope includes medicines, vaccines, devices, diagnostics, and health commodities. These product classes use substantially different regulatory, identification, packaging, clinical, and lifecycle models.
public.suggestedRevision: Define a common product-identity core and domain-specific extensions for medicinal products, devices, diagnostics, vaccines, and other commodities. Avoid one undifferentiated record model.
